caption: This drawing depicts a group of people, some wearing helmets and uniforms in shades of red, green, and blue, surrounding and interacting with a central figure who is on the ground. The central figure, dressed in brown and positioned near the bottom center of the image, is shown carrying a large, brown wooden cross. Two men on the left are using ropes to pull the central figure forward, while another group of figures behind and beside the central figure, some with halos and others in robes of red, blue, and green, either watch or support. In the background there are several spears held vertically, and to the far left, a horse with a rider is partially visible. The composition is tightly packed with overlapping figures, and there is little open space. The background is painted in muted brown and gray tones, while the figures and their clothing stand out in more saturated colors.
title: Station of the Cross No. 9: "Jesus Falls the Third Time"
